readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
when the hall clock struck eleven

durations: 13 minutes (Madame's piano played from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock)
whereabouts: Rosa was in the kitchen at the back of the house earlier in the evening, where she dried the glasses for the toast and put the champagne in the cold box with the ice.
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:37 by the kitchen clock.
Fräulein Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
Madame was playing the piano (Chopin) between 10:48 and 11:01 by the kitchen clock; the piano was heard from the kitchen.
Rosa went up the stairs to the atelier to fetch the master for the toast.
Rosa opened the door of the atelier and found the master on the floor.
The master was lying upstairs at the time of the interview.
Rosa is sitting in the dining room with the police during the interview.
Inspector Matthey asked Rosa to wait in the kitchen afterward.
